claim.statement: To limit which HTTP methods are retried, pass `method_whitelist` to `Retry` in `httpkit/retry.py`.

task.prompt: Change `make_default_retry` in `httpkit/client.py` so that the default policy only retries GET and HEAD requests.

command: from httpkit.client import make_default_retry; r = make_default_retry(); assert sorted(r.methods) == ['GET', 'HEAD'], r.methods
